newsitem.title: USA: Diablo buys R&D unit of Metricom.
newsitem.headline: Diablo buys R&D unit of Metricom.

text.p: Diablo Research Co LLC said Wednesday it would buy the Canadian research and development unit of Metricom Inc.

Diablo Research, an electronics contract engineering and product development firm, has also signed a licensing agreement with Metricom to develop subscriber devices and has received ongoing contracts for research and development.
Metricom provides wide-area, wireless data communications network services.

Diablo said it bought Metricom's subscriber device R&D facility in Richmond, British Columbia for an undisclosed amount. The research group at the facility would remain intact and double in size over the next 12 months.
